title: Apply adaptive deltas to effective values inside delay voice
description:
Modify Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h and Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp only, so each voice consumes an AdaptiveSnapshot once per block and folds its deltas into effective values using the binding layering rules.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Analysis/AdaptiveSnapshot.h (created in h.1) for the exact field names and the read() contract.
- Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h and Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp for existing base value handling, existing macro/scene delta combination, the existing adaptiveRole member, and the existing per-block control update entry point.
- Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h for how T60 currently feeds the feedback gain and where the 0.985 cap is applied.

Add to DelayVoice a method `void applyAdaptiveSnapshot (const AdaptiveSnapshot& snapshot, int voiceIndex) noexcept` called from the existing per-block control update path (never per sample, never allocating). Weight every delta by the voice's existing adaptiveRole scalar before combining. Combination rules, restated and binding:
- Wet level (dB domain): `wet_eff_dB = clamp (wet_base_dB + d_macro_dB + d_scene_dB + adaptiveRole * wetLevelDeltaDb, wet_min_dB, wet_max_dB)`; smooth in dB and convert to linear only afterward via `g = 10^(G_dB/20)`.
- T60 (octave-scaled): `t60_eff = clamp (t60_base * 2^(d_macro_oct + d_scene_oct + adaptiveRole * t60OctaveDelta), t60_min, t60_max)`; feed the existing feedback calculation `g = 10^(-3*T/T60)` and keep the existing hard cap `g_final = min (g_requested, 0.985f)`, including during Hold.
- LPF cutoff (octave-scaled): `lpf_eff = clamp (lpf_base * 2^(d_macro_oct + d_scene_oct + adaptiveRole * lpfOctaveDelta), lpf_min, lpf_max)`; smooth multiplicatively because it is strictly positive.
- Width (clamped linear addition): `width_eff = clamp (width_base + d_macro + d_scene + adaptiveRole * widthDelta, 0.0f, 2.0f)`.
- Transient softening (clamped linear addition): `soften_eff = clamp (soften_base + d_macro + d_scene + adaptiveRole * softeningDelta, 0.0f, 1.0f)`.
- Diffusion (clamped linear addition): `diffusion_eff = clamp (diffusion_base + d_macro + d_scene + adaptiveRole * diffusionDelta, 0.0f, 0.40f)`.

Smoothing: each adaptive destination gets its OWN smoothing state. A single shared smoothing envelope across destinations is forbidden. Rising contraction uses the contraction attack time and falling contraction uses the contraction release time from the existing Intelligence parameters; bloom-driven destinations use the bloom rise, hold, and release times. dB, width, softening, and diffusion use linear SmoothedValue; T60 and LPF frequency use multiplicative SmoothedValue.

This path must never call setValueNotifyingHost and must never write base APVTS values. When `snapshot.mode == 0` (Off), all adaptive deltas are treated as exactly 0.0f so the effective values reduce bit-exactly to the non-adaptive computation. Nothing added here may allocate, lock, construct strings, or resize buffers inside processBlock.

Do not modify PluginProcessor, CMakeLists.txt, tests, or anything under JUCE/.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h declares applyAdaptiveSnapshot (const AdaptiveSnapshot&, int) noexcept and Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp implements it
Wet level deltas are combined in the dB domain and converted to linear only after smoothing via 10^(G_dB/20)
T60 and LPF deltas are applied as power-of-two octave scaling and clamped to their existing ranges
Width is clamped to [0,2], transient softening to [0,1], and diffusion to [0,0.40] after clamped linear addition
The existing feedback hard cap min(g_requested, 0.985) still applies after adaptive T60 scaling, including during Hold
Each adaptive destination has its own smoothing state driven by the contraction attack/release or bloom rise/hold/release parameters; no single shared smoothing envelope is used across destinations
Source/DSP/DelayVoice.cpp contains no call to setValueNotifyingHost and no write to base APVTS values
When snapshot.mode is 0 (Off) every adaptive delta contributes exactly 0.0f
No heap allocation, lock, string construction, or buffer resize is added to any per-block or per-sample audio path in DelayVoice
cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_VST3 succeeds after this change
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: call setValueNotifyingHost or otherwise rewrite base APVTS values from the adaptive path
use one shared smoothing envelope for multiple adaptive destinations
allocate memory, lock, construct strings, or resize buffers inside processBlock or the per-block control update
remove or bypass the 0.985 feedback hard cap

allowed: add private per-destination SmoothedValue members to DelayVoice
add private helper functions for dB-to-linear and octave scaling within DelayVoice
choose where in the existing per-block control update applyAdaptiveSnapshot is invoked
forbidden: change the DelayVoice public processing interface beyond adding applyAdaptiveSnapshot
change the repeat-loop signal order inside the feedback loop
introduce a new smoothing framework or replace juce::SmoothedValue
